# Recent decisions

**Listed below are our 50 most-recently published regulatory decisions.** Many of the decisions we make about the individuals and firms we regulate are published. We aim to ensure decisions we publish are accurate and up to date. However, this website does not offer a complete picture of an individual's or firm's regulatory record. To check whether a law firm or an individual  is regulated by us, and for relevant information about them  you can search our Solicitor Register. For the most complete, up-to-date information we can offer about an individual's or firm's regulatory record, please contact us.

We continue to develop our website to improve the way in which you can search for decisions. You can also subscribe to our RSS feed which displays the 20 most-recently published decisions.
